mapper.select: SELECT ORDER_ID, MEMBER_ID, ORDER_STATUS, ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE, TOSS_ORDER_ID, PAYMENT_KEY FROM ORDERS WHERE TOSS_ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = 'PAID', PAYMENT_KEY = #{paymentKey}, PAID_AT = NOW() WHERE TOSS_ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER_ID, MEMBER_ID, ORDER_STATUS, ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE, TOSS_ORDER_ID, PAYMENT_KEY FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT P JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID SET P.PRODUCT_STOCK = P.PRODUCT_STOCK - OI.ORDER_ITEM_QTY WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND P.PRODUCT_STOCK >= OI.ORDER_ITEM_QTY
UPDATE PRODUCT P JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID SET P.PRODUCT_STOCK = P.PRODUCT_STOCK + OI.ORDER_ITEM_QTY WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_STOCK AS productStock, OI.ORDER_ITEM_QTY AS requiredQty FROM PRODUCT P JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
